title: Strict constant-coefficient towers and normalized inverse/direct-image operations
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\underline B_X$ be the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and let $\mathcal T_X=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline B_X))$ be strict towers [def-weil-inverse-system], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], index $n$ representing positive level $n+1$. Use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal T_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a map $f:X\to Y$, define termwise inverse image and direct image using the canonical constant-section coefficient identification and the existing module operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $G_f$ be the exact descent of termwise inverse image and $R_f$ the total right derived termwise direct image, with the termwise induced normalized adjunction $G_f\dashv R_f$. Define the ordinary direct-image identity and compositor by restriction along the fibre-product identity and pasting isomorphisms [def-pc-fibre-product]; define the inverse-image identity and compositor by conjugation, and descend them to $G$, defining the $R$ identities and compositors as their conjugates [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Evaluation is exact descent of evaluation at $n$, its inverse-image comparison is the termwise one, and its direct-image comparison is the adjunction mate of that comparison.

proof.text: Identify inverse image of the constant ring sheaf with the constant ring sheaf using the constant-sheaf/evaluation adjunction at the terminal pro-etale object and uniqueness of left adjoints. Compute the composite comparison by the adjunction formula and pullback-pasting restrictions; this proves constantRing_isIso and constantRingIso_comp for the specified maps.

Work at the original site and coefficient universes. The category of modules is Grothendieck abelian by the existing ringed-site theorem. Filtered colimits in towers are exact pointwise. The coproduct of the evaluation left adjoints applied to a module separator is a tower separator: transpose a detecting map at an index. Thus towers are Grothendieck abelian, and the existing general resolution instance gives unbounded K-injective resolutions.

The already exact module inverse-image functor preserves finite limits and colimits after postcomposition on the functor category. This proves towerPullback_exact pointwise without a diagram-site replacement.

Specialize the existing arbitrary-ring-sheaf pullback/direct-image composition theorem to the constant coefficient isomorphisms and their proved compositor equality. Extract its section-normalized ordinary direct-image isomorphism. Any two such isomorphisms agree by extensionality on modules, site objects and sections.

For the identity, identify the adjoint coefficient map with the constant direct-image map using the adjunction hom equivalence. Sheafification naturality identifies that map with restriction along the identity pullback isomorphism. Apply pushforwardCongr₂ along the inverse graph and then pushforwardId; their component formula is exactly the required normalization. Extensionality proves uniqueness.
Evaluation commutes definitionally with the termwise inverse-image functor. The ordinary mate of its inverse comparison is the identity by the right adjunction triangle.

Compute the derived mate after the right-derived units using the derived adjunction mate factorization. The exact-square factorization follows from the derived composition and natural-isomorphism factorization lemmas; the homotopy mate is the termwise ordinary mate. Every derived tower has a K-injective representative, evaluation preserves its K-injectivity, and both derived units on these representatives are invertible. Since the ordinary evaluation mate is the identity, the factorization is a composite of isomorphisms. Cancel the invertible factors and transport across the representative isomorphism to prove evalR_isIso.
